metadata.training: AR(2) log1p ridge, fixed L2=20, standardization from each training prefix only; >=32 training pairs. COVID indicator in all AR variants. Lag selection frozen from 2016-2017 only; no 2017 calibration scores reused.
metadata.paired_support: All six methods share identical origin/target rows within scenario/horizon. M gaps remain missing. Frozen selected lags yield more M pairs than the prior 8-lag main harness: these are different comparison cohorts.
metadata.features: Season adds June-November flag and sin/cos; weather adds selected rainfall, temperature and humidity lags, selected rainfall window, >=1mm rain days and weekly temperature min/max at lag 1. Combined adds a fixed research cumulative-200mm onset proxy, not PAGASA onset. No-engineered combined variant drops rainfall roll/rain-day/min/max/onset engineering.
metadata.calibration: Only prior out-of-sample targets matured by each origin. Calibration starts in 2018; first 20 matured rows have unavailable probabilities and intervals.
metadata.thermal: Optional thermal index omitted: no verified parameter curve is implemented; never labelled tested.
metadata.operational: No environmental model is promoted. Public persistence baseline remains independent of weather availability. No current dengue observations exist.
metadata.bootstrap: 400 circular moving blocks of 8 observed rows, seed 20261025, 95% skill CI versus matched persistence; gaps mean observed blocks are not necessarily eight calendar weeks.

comparison.time_caveat: ERA5 Asia/Manila civil days versus NASA POWER LST solar-swath days; weekly boundaries may differ.

design.selection_rule: Maximum absolute log-case Pearson association in 2016-2017 training only, tie earliest; rainfall windows 1/2/4/8 selected there too. No test years consulted. Associations are confounded by season, not causal.

drivers.interpretation: Descriptive standardized coefficients in final historical training fit; no causal interpretation or test-year lag selection.
